579-3360-6723.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}{R} due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

719-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
719-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

529-7175-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3967-4871-8168.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
728-6730-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat.

1492-2866-4247-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4247-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

5256-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5256-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-7084-7892.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2043-4050-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six multicolored permanents.
2043-4050-6741.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Robots, adding {6}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-2700-6972.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

5686-5702-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1430-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image
1430-5299-5466.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirror Image's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mirror Image's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mirror Image's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-6705-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Frog and Insect by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2060-2946-3967-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-3967-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

796-1762-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

5329-5361-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Auton Soldier do not have summoning sickness.
5329-5361-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Auton Soldier.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Auton Soldier.
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1430-2092-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
1430-2092-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirror Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirror Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirror Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-2557-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4871-5147-5544.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers when Forsaken Miner dies, and Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Forsaken Miner trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat.

509-625-1267-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-625-1267-5547.description:
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Medomai the Ageless and causing it to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

1496-3263-4050-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1496-3263-4050-4078-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

82-618-3057.notablePrerequisites:
Sting attached to Kiki-Jiki.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
82-618-3057.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Sting triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster with haste.
Deal combat damage using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

486-1102-1636-4186.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
486-1102-1636-4186.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's first ability by tapping it, causing Scurry Oak to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

423-765-1313-1437.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-765-1313-1437.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1651-1737.notablePrerequisites: Any artifact with mana value 0 exiled by Prototype Portal.
1308-1651-1737.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating two token copies of the imprinted artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two artifact tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-3779-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-3779-4658.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Soul of Eternity and gaining life equal to its power.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

150-2570-3519.description:
Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it.
Titania's second ability triggers, creating a 5/3 Elemental creature token.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Titania, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to have Titania put into the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Command Beacon ability from step 1, putting Titania from the command zone into your hand.
Cast Titania by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Titania enters the battlefield, returning Command Beacon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

614-1283-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1283-1987-3075.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
